notes.title: 🧰 Update 3 - Photo Mode 🧰
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/a67da61f53a15acce9a3d4f36f34b4393afc25cc.png[/img]

Hello vagabond friends,

If you enjoy exploring the landscapes of Cigalo as much as we loved crafting them, then the new [b]PHOTO MODE update[/b] is just for you! It’s available NOW with a fantastic [b]20% discount[/b] (don’t forget to share with your friends)! 🎉

Watch the trailer to discover the many inspirations that brought this vibrant world to life, and let it spark your creativity for those perfect shots. Grab your cameras and let’s hit the Van! ☀️

[previewyoutube=4kEvX4CT6NM;full][/previewyoutube]

We greatly appreciate your continued support. We've been gathering your feedback and bug reports from Steam and Discord, and we're working hard to investigate and resolve them!

🗒️ Here's the changelog:

[h2]Additions/Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Photo Mode to unleash your inner photographer!
[/list]

[h2]Major Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when starting the game.
[*] Fixed Cepe's quest taxi spline not being visible
[/list]

[h2]Medium Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the community service achievement not unlocking for some users.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with French text translation.
[*] Fixed the word "Quoi?" not being translated when speaking to Nefle during the Aqueduct setup sequence.
[*] Fixed translation of the Nomad Seeds item name.
[*] Fixed the tomb door in Lamarr's quest disappearing after changing chapters.
[*] Fixed some door names not being translated when using the antenna scanner.
[/list]


If you have any ideas or suggestions, don't hesitate to share them with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1582650/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url] or the [url=https://discord.gg/u75vFF4ntD]official Caravan SandWitch Discord[/url]!

Hi Villagers of Cigalo,

Thank you for your support all along the way. We've been collecting your feedback and bug reports on Steam & Discord, and we're doing our best to investigate and fix them!

[h2]Additions/Improvements:[/h2]

[*] Improved clarity of objectives for all "Receptacle quests."
[*] Enhanced level art around the jammer in the Croaking Forest.
[/list]

[h2]Major Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed save restoration issues.
[*] Fixed game freeze when opening the pause menu after making the final choice in the end sequence.
[*] Fixed "Baie quest" not marked as completed when loading a save file if vehicle parts were collected before starting the quest.
[*] Fixed "Lamarr quest" not triggering properly if the robots in the Refuge are met in the last chapter.
[*] Fixed "Curry quest" becoming unfinishable if the Nomad Door sequence isn't completed first.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading a save during the game's ending would revert progress to the point of no return.
[*] Fixed bridge button to access the wind turbine transformer top being non-interactive.
[/list]

[h2]Medium Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed relays in Nefle Hub.
[*] Fixed interaction conditions with relay levers.
[*] Fixed "Lamarr quest" not closing properly if missed.
[*] Fixed the final quest thread before the ending not pointing to talking with Rose.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed oversized text in the Station.
[*] Removed an unintended gray wall in the first room of the Station.
[*] Fixed invisible collision on a container in the Docks.
[*] Fixed all archived quest threads showing as time-limited.
[*] Changed the color of scrap objective text to black for better readability.
[*] Updated Receptacle toaster quest images to match the new relay appearance.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/ce36e58e43370d9761947ca45155fe85e92d061b.jpg[/img]

Hi Villagers of Cigalo,

5 days to go! Are you excited about the release? Either way, if you haven't played the demo yet, feel free to download it on [url=https://www.caravansandwitch.com/]Steam[/url] while you enjoy your weekend!

In the meantime, here's an update on the features and we've added based on your feedback! Let’s dive in!
[hr][/hr] [h3]📸 Photo Mode 📸[/h3]
There you go! The photo mode will be available [u][b]at a later date after the launch[/b][/u]! It's compatible with keyboard mouse and controllers. You'll be able to rebind the button in your preferences!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/79fd7b0077294e5adbd263044eab940a670acdb3.gif[/img]
[h3]Can we do it with the van? Yes of coz 😎🚌[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/96e3391a245512f57436d60b618811d443a58bd0.png[/img][hr][/hr] [h3]💫 Say Goodbye to Motion Sickness 😵[/h3]
Many of you have experienced the problem of motion sickness in the game. We've now added a ''Motion Sickness Reduction Mode'' option to the settings! If you turn it on, the camera will be more stable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/a7c8dbd6d6a9adfd92d2c8eb47819c5c5b20a468.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr] [h3]🚍 Van Stuck Detection 💥[/h3]
Stuck with your van in some weird places? No worries! We've added a new UI to help you get back to the garage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/c6967696dc5b0dc4a2b3b123f615804d3177bf3c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr] Thank you for your support⭐and see you soon! 😎

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/b8430ff7debeecdef132682590eb53e9468033c5.jpg[/img]

Hi Villagers of Cigalo,

Are you all ready for your adventure in Cigalo? As you may have seen, the game is set to release in September 2024! If you missed the release window announcement and the trailer, be sure to check them out!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1582650/view/4336488362959942684
In the meantime, let’s update you on what we’ve been working on based on your feedback. Let’s dive in!
[hr][/hr] [h3]🚍 New Enter/Exit Transition 🚍 [/h3]
Instead of a fade-to-black, we've implemented a new transition to make it smoother than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/1760109bed93fc66eec78c694756d10aa500e40e.gif[/img]

[h3]📌 No More Getting Lost! 📌[/h3]
As we mentioned last time, once you've placed markers on the map, you’ll now be able to see them on your mini-map. This will make it easier for you to locate your destinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/ce58ee05ed02a6b01db332aff93c594a7dd463fd.gif[/img]

[h3]📝UI Update in the Slot Selection Menu 📝[/h3]
Your playtime and progress (chapter) will now be displayed before you start a new game or continue your save. We’ve also added an option for you to restore your saves to previous versions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/e5dedcde94611b29a8621f2c6988e1b1a1b93e94.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr] That’s all for now! Of course, we’ve also done a lot of optimization work on the game, so you’ll likely notice those changes in the full release.

Stay tuned and don’t forget to join our community! 😎

Thank you for your support! ⭐

notes.title: 🐸 Dev Update #1 🐸
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/03595694559c127bfe50635353b50dfadc3ff1ac.jpg[/img]

Hi Villagers of Cigalo,

Since the demo is no longer available (don’t be disappointed), we have to wait until the full release of the game. 😭

By the way, we've received a lot of constructive feedback during the Steam Next Fest, and we're currently working on it. Shall we take a look at those issues and discuss what we’re doing to improve the game?
[hr][/hr] [h3]🚩 Place a Marker 🚩[/h3]
We’ve reworked the map to make it clearer than before! You can now place markers all over the map to mark your next destination or record places you’ve visited if you want to go back again! ⛳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/0c35a60efc7c11cbe1134440dc250b535e917c6f.gif[/img]

[h3]📷 Camera Rotation 📷[/h3]
We have added an option to switch off the automatic camera rotation! You can now set your own angle, and we can't wait to see your beautiful screenshots! 🥰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/113f71d3a63312eb0432a780dc50a8d64f7aab88.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/dd5293731623db0fca90a9cebc420386e8d9a21f.gif[/img]

[h3]🔊 Noise from Interactive Objects 🔊[/h3]
We're currently discussing the sound issue with our Sound Designer. Also, we have already implemented an option to deactivate the notification sound when approaching objects such as ladders, van, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40150796/a9916ffbe1f40282f39279eed4aa96eadac8a794.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr] For other feedback, such as FPS drops or the fade-back animation, we're still working on it! We'll keep you updated once we have something to share!

Stay tuned and don’t forget to join our community! 😎

Thank you for your support! ⭐
